experiment_data.hypothesis: An optimized CoT prompt with structured reasoning steps and calibrated examples will improve LLM-as-Judge jailbreak detection F1, especially on OOD datasets (DD, AA), compared to the original 3-shot prompt

spec.conclusion_detail: CoT+persuasion taxonomy optimized prompt improves LLM-as-judge AA F1 from 0.627→0.885, but still below DAPT (0.953-1.000). Original AA=0.627, Optimized AA=0.885. Prompt template written to appendix.
